panels.title: Overview — is EDDI healthy right now?
Agents
panels.description: `eddi_agents_deployed` — agents currently in a deployed state.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: `eddi_processing_conversation_count` — turns being processed right now.

panels.title: Turns/sec
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_conversation_processing_count_total` — pipeline throughput.

panels.title: Tool success
panels.description: success / (success + failure). Cached and rate-limited calls are excluded — they are neither a success nor a failure of the tool itself.

panels.title: Cache hits
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_hits_total` / (hits + misses).

panels.title: Task errors/sec
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_pipeline_task_errors_total` across every lifecycle task.

panels.title: Tool spend
panels.description: `eddi_tool_costs_total` gauge — dollars accrued since process start.

panels.title: Gate verified
panels.description: `eddi_operator_gate_verified` — 1 only while every provisioned operator version read back with a sound approval gate. 0 also means 'never reported', so a fresh deployment reads 0. This is the meter worth alerting on.

panels.title: Conversation lifecycle rate
panels.description: All six `eddi_conversation_*_count_total` counters.

panels.title: Lifecycle latency (avg)
panels.description: `_seconds_sum / _seconds_count` for each lifecycle timer. These timers publish no histogram buckets, so a true percentile is not available — this is the interval mean.

panels.title: Lifecycle latency (peak)
panels.description: `_seconds_max` — the slowest single observation in each decay window.

panels.title: Conversations in flight
panels.description: `eddi_processing_conversation_count`

panels.title: Agents deployed
panels.description: `eddi_agents_deployed`

panels.title: Owner-scan exhausted
panels.description: `eddi_conversations_listing_owner_scan_exhausted_total` — a conversation listing gave up before filling the requested page. Sustained non-zero means the owner filter is scanning too much; the caller sees a short page.

panels.title: Session checkpoints by action
panels.description: `eddi_session_checkpoint_count_total` by `action` — session fork/snapshot activity.

panels.title: Coordinator queue depth
panels.description: `eddi_coordinator_queue_depth` — conversations waiting for a slot. Sustained growth means arrival outpaces processing.

panels.title: Coordinator active conversations
panels.description: `eddi_coordinator_active_conversations`

panels.title: Coordinator throughput
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_coordinator_total_processed_total`.

panels.title: Task duration P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: `eddi_pipeline_task_duration_seconds_bucket`. This is the only EDDI timer that calls `publishPercentileHistogram()`, so it is the only one where a real quantile exists.

panels.title: Task duration P99 by task type
panels.description: Which lifecycle task is slow. Note the label is `task_type` — Micrometer converts the `task.type` tag key to an underscore.

panels.title: Task error rate by error type
panels.description: `eddi_pipeline_task_errors_total` by `error_type`.

panels.title: Task errors by task and error type (5m)
panels.description: Exact failing task ids. `increase` over 5m, top 25.

panels.title: Execution outcomes
panels.description: The four terminal outcomes of `ToolExecutionService.executeToolWrapped()`. Stacked, because every wrapped call lands in exactly one.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_calls_total` by `tool`.

panels.title: Execution latency by tool (avg)
panels.description: `eddi_tool_execution_duration_seconds` mean per tool.

panels.title: Execution latency (peak)
panels.description: `_seconds_max` per tool.

panels.title: Failures by tool (1h)
panels.description: Which tools actually break.

panels.title: Budget exceeded
panels.description: `eddi_tool_budget_exceeded_total` — a conversation hit its cost ceiling and the call was refused.

panels.title: Cumulative tool spend
panels.description: `eddi_tool_costs_total` gauge.

panels.title: Spend rate by tool
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_tool_costs_total{tool}` — dollars per second, per tool.

panels.title: Spend by tool (24h)
panels.description: Where the money went.

panels.title: Hits vs misses
panels.description: Aggregate `eddi_tool_cache_hits_total` / `_misses_total`.

panels.title: Cache size
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_size` — live entry count.

panels.title: Hits by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_hits_by_tool_total`

panels.title: Misses by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_misses_by_tool_total`

panels.title: Puts by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_puts_by_tool_total`

panels.title: Cache bypassed by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_bypassed_total` — caching was enabled but no identity could scope the entry, so both read and write were skipped. Sustained non-zero means calls arrive with neither a user id nor a conversation id and pay full tool cost every time. Investigate the caller rather than widening cache scope.

panels.title: Cache get / put latency (avg)
panels.description: `eddi_tool_cache_{get,put}_duration_seconds` mean.

panels.title: Denied by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_ratelimit_denied_total` by `tool`.

panels.title: Remaining capacity by tool
panels.description: `eddi_tool_ratelimit_remaining` — tokens left in the most constrained bucket for each tool. Approaching zero means the next call is about to be denied.

panels.title: Cascade token rate by provider
panels.description: `eddi_llm_cascade_tokens_total` — tokens/sec.

panels.title: Cascade spend rate by provider
panels.description: `eddi_llm_cascade_cost_total`

panels.title: Cascade confidence (avg)
panels.description: `eddi_llm_cascade_confidence` distribution summary. Falling confidence means the cascade is escalating more often.

panels.title: Streaming downgraded by reason
panels.description: `eddi_llm_streaming_downgraded_total` — a streaming request fell back to non-streaming (e.g. `reason=tools_enabled`).

panels.title: Streaming without partials
panels.description: `eddi_llm_streaming_no_partials_total` — the stream produced no incremental tokens, so the user waited for a single block.

panels.title: Tool-context evictions by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_llm_tool_context_evictions_total` — tool-result exchanges dropped to fit the token budget, incremented by the number evicted. `outcome=still_over_budget` means eviction ran and the context is *still* too large, so the model is about to see a truncated history. Registered through `Metrics.globalRegistry`.

panels.title: Cascade executions by agent mode
panels.description: Cascade runs started, split by whether agent mode (tool calling) was in use. The denominator for every other panel in this row.

panels.title: Escalations by reason
panels.description: Why the cascade moved to a more expensive model: low_confidence, timeout, or an error type. A cascade that never escalates is paying for steps it does not use; one that always escalates is paying twice for every turn.

panels.title: Accepted step (which model actually answered)
panels.description: Index of the cascade step whose answer was accepted. Mass at step 0 means the cheap model is carrying the load — the whole point of cascading. Mass at the last step means the cascade is pure overhead.

panels.title: Step errors by provider and type
panels.description: Errors raised by an individual cascade step, tagged with the provider that failed. These are absorbed by escalation, so they do not surface as request failures — this panel is the only place they are visible.

panels.title: Ceiling exceeded (cost / duration)
panels.description: Cascade runs cut short because the configured cost or duration ceiling was hit. Non-zero means users are receiving the best answer obtained so far rather than the best answer available.

panels.title: Tool-result guardrail by action
panels.description: `guardrail_toolresult_count_total` by `action` — what the guardrail did to the result.

panels.title: Tool-result guardrail by source
panels.description: …and which tool source triggered it.

panels.title: MCP response truncation
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_response_truncation_count_total` by `strategy` — oversized tool responses being cut down before they reach the model.

panels.title: Counterweight activations by level
panels.description: `eddi_counterweight_activation_count_total` by `level` (normal / cautious / strict).

panels.title: Strict counterweight downgraded
panels.description: `eddi_counterweight_strict_downgraded_total` — a strict counterweight could not be honoured and was reduced. Worth alerting on if the strict level is a compliance control.

panels.title: Identity masking applied
panels.description: `eddi_identity_masking_applied_total` — outbound payloads with identity masked.

panels.title: Turn-level pause / resume by surface
panels.description: `eddi_hitl_pause_count_total` / `_resume_count_total` by `surface` (`regular` = single conversation, `group` = group discussion). A pause rate that outruns resume means approvals are piling up.

panels.title: Approval timeouts by surface
panels.description: `eddi_hitl_timeout_count_total` — nobody answered in time and the timeout policy fired.

panels.title: Tool-call gate pause / resume
panels.description: `eddi_hitl_tool_pause_count_total` and `eddi_hitl_tool_resume_count_total{verdict}` — the per-tool-call approval gate.

panels.title: Approval rule matches
panels.description: `eddi_hitl_rule_matched_total` by `match` — which `hitlConfig.toolApprovals` `requireApproval` pattern matched, counted once per distinct rule per gated call. A pattern that never appears here is dead config.

panels.title: Operator write approvals by decision
panels.description: `eddi_operator_write_approval_total` by `decision` (approved / rejected / timeout) — one per gated operator write the moment it resolves.

panels.title: Tool gate guards by guard
panels.description: `eddi_hitl_tool_guard_count_total` by `guard` — a safety guard (e.g. `pause_cap`) stopped the gate rather than the human.

panels.title: MCP approval decisions
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_hitl_decision_total` by `verdict`.

panels.title: MCP approvals cancelled
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_hitl_cancelled_total`

panels.title: MCP pending-approval listings
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_hitl_pending_listed_total`

panels.title: Discussion failure rate
panels.description: failures / started.

panels.title: Discussion duration
panels.description: `eddi_group_discussion_duration_seconds`.

panels.title: Discussion outcomes
panels.description: How discussions end.

panels.title: Facilitator moves by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_group_facilitator_moves_total` by `outcome` — `proposed` is every move the model asked for, `executed` the ones allowed, `rejected` the ones the bounded-move config refused. A large proposed/executed gap means the facilitator is repeatedly attempting moves it is not permitted to make.

panels.title: Facilitator moves by move type (1h)
panels.description: `move` is bounded to the FacilitatorMove enum names plus UNKNOWN, so this label is safe to group by.

panels.title: Group cost
panels.description: `eddi_group_cost_dollars` gauge.

panels.title: Cost ceiling hits
panels.description: `eddi_group_cost_ceiling_hit_total` — a discussion was cut off by its budget. Already `_total`-suffixed in source, so Micrometer does not add another.

panels.title: Member pauses skipped
panels.description: `eddi_group_member_pause_skipped_count_total` — a HUMAN member's turn did not pause when it should have.

panels.title: Team cadence runs
panels.description: `eddi_team_cadence_runs_{started,skipped}_total` — scheduled standing-team cadences.

panels.title: Team cadence writebacks & reclaims
panels.description: Reclaimed claims mean a cadence holder died mid-run and another node took over.

panels.title: Dead-lettered fires
panels.description: `eddi_schedule_fire_deadlettered_total` — retries exhausted; the trigger will not run again without intervention.

panels.title: Claim conflicts
panels.description: `eddi_schedule_claim_conflict_total` — two nodes raced for the same fire. A low rate is normal cluster behaviour; a high one means the poll interval is too tight.

panels.title: Dream throughput
panels.description: `dream_*_total` — the DreamService consolidation pass.

panels.title: Dream failures
panels.description: A failing cycle leaves memory unconsolidated; it does not lose data.

panels.title: Contradictions found
panels.description: `dream_contradictions_found_total` — conflicting memory entries detected.

panels.title: Summarization calls vs errors
panels.description: `summarization_calls_total` / `summarization_errors_total` — the shared summarizer used by both Dream and conversation windowing.

panels.title: Prompt snippet cache
panels.description: `eddi_snippets_cache_{hits,misses}_total` — Caffeine cache in `PromptSnippetService`.

panels.title: Integrations — MCP, A2A Identity, OpenAI-compatible API
MCP discovery by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_discovery_total`

panels.title: MCP conversation access denied
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_conversation_access_denied_total` — an MCP tool tried to reach a conversation it is not scoped to.

panels.title: Agent signing & verification
panels.description: `eddi_agent_identity_*` — A2A peer message signing. A non-zero verify-fail rate is a security signal, not a performance one.

panels.title: Nonce rejections
panels.description: `eddi_agent_nonce_*_rejected_total`. Clock-skew rejections usually mean unsynchronised peers rather than an attack; replay rejections do not.

panels.title: OpenAI-compatible requests
panels.description: `eddi_openai_requests_total` by `outcome` — the `/v1` adapter.

panels.title: OpenAI-compatible requests by mode
panels.description: …by `mode` (streaming vs blocking).

panels.title: Conversations created via /v1
panels.description: `eddi_openai_conversations_created_total` — each new Open WebUI chat maps to a fresh EDDI conversation.

panels.title: Attachments
panels.description: `eddi_attachment_*_total` — multimodal attachment handling.

panels.title: Capability queries
panels.description: `eddi_capability_query_count_total` vs `eddi_capability_miss_count_total`.

panels.title: Top missing skills (1h)
panels.description: `eddi_capability_miss_count_total` by `skill` — capabilities agents asked for and no registered agent could serve. This is a backlog of missing agents.

panels.title: Match strategy applied
panels.description: `eddi_capability_strategy_applied_total` by `strategy` — which matching strategy won.

panels.title: Connection resolution by outcome
panels.description: `connection_resolve_count_total`

panels.title: Connection resolve latency
panels.description: `connection_resolve_time_seconds`. The tag key is `authType` in source and stays camelCase in Prometheus — only dots become underscores.

targets.expr:
sum by (binding, authType) (rate(connection_resolve_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / clamp_min(sum by (binding, authType) (rate(connection_resolve_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Missing connection grants by binding
panels.description: `connection_grant_missing_count_total` — a binding asked for a grant that is not configured. This is a config gap, not a runtime error.

panels.title: Caller identity resolution by reference
panels.description: `eddi_caller_identity_resolution_total` by `reference` — `token` vs `userId`.

panels.title: Caller identity resolution
panels.description: `eddi_caller_identity_resolution_total` by `outcome` — `${caller:token}` / `${caller:userId}` resolution. Failures fail closed, so a rising failure rate means HTTP calls are being refused rather than sent unauthenticated.

panels.title: Vault cache hits vs misses
panels.description: `eddi_vault_cache_{hits,misses}_total` in `SecretResolver`.

panels.title: Vault errors
panels.description: `eddi_vault_errors_count_total` (provider) and `eddi_vault_resolve_errors_total` (resolver). A resolve error means a `${vault:...}` reference did not resolve — the dependent HTTP call or model provider is now failing.

panels.title: Vault operations
panels.description: `eddi_vault_{resolve,store,delete,rotate}_count_total`.

panels.title: Vault latency (avg)
panels.description: Three distinct timers, not duplicates: `eddi_vault_resolve_time_seconds` is measured in `SecretResolver` (cache included), `eddi_vault_resolve_duration_seconds` in `VaultSecretProvider` (the backing store only). The gap between them is what the cache is saving you.

panels.title: Quota allowed vs denied
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_quota_allowed_total` counts slot acquisitions only — the read-only gates (`checkAgentQuota`, `checkCostBudget`) deliberately do not touch it, so treat this as acquisitions vs all denials rather than a strict ratio.

panels.title: Quota denials by type
panels.description:
`eddi_tenant_quota_denied_total` by `type` (conversation / api_call / agent / cost).

The `tenant!=""` filter is not redundant. Before the tag-key collision in `TenantQuotaService` was fixed, this counter was also registered untagged, and Prometheus keeps those old samples for its whole retention window after an upgrade. Without the filter that legacy series renders as a nameless extra row here for days. The aggregate panel deliberately omits the filter so it still counts them.

panels.title: Quota denials by tenant (1h)
panels.description: Who is hitting their limits. Filtered to tagged series — see the by-type panel.

panels.title: Tenant usage rate
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_usage_{conversations,api_calls}_total` by `tenant`.

panels.title: Tenant spend rate
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_usage_cost_total` by `tenant`.

panels.title: Audit entries dropped
panels.description: `eddi_audit_entries_dropped_total` — the audit ledger shed an entry rather than grow the heap. Any sustained non-zero value is a compliance problem under the EU AI Act: the ledger is no longer a complete record. Alert on this.

panels.title: Gate verified
panels.description: `eddi_operator_gate_verified` — 1 only while every provisioned operator version read back with a sound approval gate.

panels.title: Canary outcomes
panels.description: `eddi_operator_canary_total` by `outcome`.

panels.title: NATS JetStream (when the NATS coordinator is enabled)
Dead-lettered messages
panels.description: `eddi_nats_dead_letter_count_total` — a conversation message exhausted its retries.

panels.title: HTTP request rate by status
panels.description: Quarkus `http-server` binder. Unlike EDDI's own timers this one does publish buckets.

panels.title: GC pause rate
panels.description: Seconds of GC pause per second. Above ~0.1 the JVM is spending 10% of wall clock collecting.

panels.title: Connection pools
panels.description: EDDI is database-agnostic; whichever backend is active reports, the other shows no data.

title: E.D.D.I — Full Metrics Reference
description: Every meter E.D.D.I registers with Micrometer, grouped by subsystem. Counters are shown as rates, timers as mean and peak from _seconds_sum/_seconds_count/_seconds_max. Only eddi_pipeline_task_duration publishes histogram buckets, so it is the only EDDI timer with true percentiles. Companion to the Operations Command Center dashboard.
